name: @zof-ai/gate
description: Zof release gate client: block a CI/CD deploy on the Zof Control Plane's decision.
author: Zof AI, Inc.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/action-main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --charset=utf8 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// Generated by npm run bundle from src/; do not edit." --outfile=dist/index.mjs
scripts.bundle:check: npm run bundle && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist)"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
